programme.title: Arthur: Popular Girls/Buster's Growing Grudge
programme.desc: Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur: Desert Island Dish/The Secret About Secrets
programme.desc: When Mr. Ratburn challenges the class to find the perfect food for surviving on a desert island, everyone picks potato chips or ice cream! D.W. is told a secret and quickly learns that keeping one is a lot harder than she thought.
programme.sub-title: Desert Island Dish/The Secret About Secrets

programme.title: Arthur: Buster's Green Thumb/My Fair Tommy
programme.desc: Buster finds out that his collection of old food makes excellent compost--which makes for even better tomatoes! Then, neither of the Tibble twins has ever won the coveted "Good Behavior of the Week" cupcake award.

programme.title: Arthur: When Duty Calls – Parts 1 & 2
programme.desc: Ladonna finds out the Army is transferring her dad to Oregon, and the whole Compson family is moving again. Fern and the others can tell Ladonna is upset, but don’t know how to help. What can they do to make the transition easier?

programme.title: Arthur: Three's a Crowd/A is for Angry
programme.desc: Prunella's loves doing yoga with her mom, but when her best friend joins them, will she be able to share her time? When Arthur decides to take on The Brain at a checkers competition, everyone rallies behind the underdog.
programme.sub-title: Three's a Crowd/A is for Angry

programme.title: Arthur: He Said, He Said/Bunny Trouble
programme.desc: A special episode of Bionic Bunny is interrupted, and Arthur and friends try to remember what comes next. D.W. is excited to be taking care of the class bunny, Larry. But Larry is feeling adventurous and and wanders off.

programme.title: Arthur: Baseball Blues/Brain's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: It's Grebelings season and George can't wait to play! After all, no one knows more about baseball than George. Then, wBrain gets teamed with Buster and Binky in the annual Arithmattack competition.

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. Aims High/Flaw and Order
programme.desc: D.W. wants to be the first person to set foot on Mars! But what if scary purple aliens eat her? Who's responsible for cracking Dad's cake platter? DUN-DUN! All the evidence points to Arthur!

programme.title: Arthur: All Thumbs/Kidonia
programme.desc: When Arthur catches Buster sucking his thumb, Buster worries that Arthur will tell the entire school. Tired of doing chores, Arthur and friends decide to invent their own country. Will this kid-ruled utopia flourish or descend into anarchy?

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline
programme.desc: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline

programme.title: Arthur: Francine's Big Top Trouble/George Blows His Top
programme.desc: Francine is sure she will be a star at circus camp. How hard could it be? Then, George is always more than happy to lend his pals whatever they need. But Buster's borrowing gets out of control.
programme.sub-title: Francine's Big Top Trouble/George Blows His Top

programme.title: Arthur: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish

programme.title: Arthur: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story/Sue Ellen Vegges Out
programme.desc: Fern has writer's block! Fortunately, Ladonna's full of stories, and Fern decides to "borrow" the tales and simply change the names. Then, when Sue Ellen decides to stop eating meat, Muffy and Francine compete to be the best vegetarian.
programme.sub-title: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story/Sue Ellen Vegges Out

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Tooth/D.W. Gets Lost
programme.desc: It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. Thinks Big/Arthur Cleans Up
programme.desc: Once again, Arthur gets to do everything. Mostly he gets to carry the ring in Aunt Lucy's wedding. Elwood City's park is in sad shape, and after grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteered to clean it up.

programme.title: Arthur: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend
programme.desc: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.
programme.sub-title: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Read: Super Saver!/Tibbles to the Rescue!
programme.desc: Business is slow for Mr. and Mrs. Read, and Arthur is concerned. Can he find ways to keep his family in the green? When D.W. saves Tommy and Timmy from a nasty fall, they decide to repay the favor…whether D.W. likes it or not.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Read: Super Saver!/Tibbles to the Rescue!

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Makes Waves/It Came From Beyond
programme.desc: With the community pool closed for repairs and the temperature on the rise, Arthur and D.W. need a place to keep cool. Then, Grandma Thora takes in a stray: an adorable little dog named...Killer?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes Waves/It Came From Beyond

programme.title: Arthur: Silent Treatment/Kung Fool
programme.desc: When shy George wonders if any of his friends notice him, he decides he won’t speak to anyone until they do! Fern volunteers to help an elderly neighbor with his household chores, and then discovers his past life as a Kung Fu celebrity.

programme.title: D.W. and the Beastly Birthday
programme.desc: Time to put on your party hats and dancing shoes – D.W. is turning five! When her birthday doesn’t go as planned, D.W. runs away to the magical island of Ukubonga. This is one party you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Arthur: MacFrensky/The Good The Bad and the Binky
programme.desc: Cheating comes in to play when Francine and Brain are locked in a stiff competition to win student of the month. Babysitter Binky introduces his charge to the world of pro-wrestling, but is he being a good role model?
programme.sub-title: MacFrensky/The Good The Bad and the Binky

programme.title: Arthur: Lend Me Your Ear/The Butler Did It
programme.desc: Arthur, Buster, and Brain are worried when Mr. Ratburn isn't acting like himself. He's always pleased to see them, so what’s made him change? When Mr. Crosswire gets a robot butler for Father's Day, Muffy fears Bailey may be replaced.
programme.sub-title: Lend Me Your Ear/The Butler Did It

programme.title: Arthur: Binky Vs. Binky/Operation: DW!
programme.desc: Binky may be tough and strong, but when it comes to sports, he always seems to choke. D.W. is having trouble hearing and needs an ear operation. Is it okay to be just a little bit scared?

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Loses His Marbles/Friday The 13th
programme.desc: When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

programme.title: Arthur: Fifteen
programme.desc: How much can Arthur and his friends do in 15 minutes? Can they all accomplish these missions impossible before the clock counts all the way down? Only time will tell!

programme.title: Arthur: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister
programme.desc: What's a budding entrepreneur to do when her homemade cookies hit the big time? Especially when the recipe isn't really hers? Then, Arthur and Francine would love to lend their sisters to Sue Ellen, who's sick of being an only child.
programme.sub-title: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister

programme.title: Arthur: Brain's Brain/Brain Sees Stars
programme.desc: Brain's Easter egg hunts are notoriously hard. But this year's might prove impossible if Brain can't remember where he hid the final egg. Then, crazy coincidences have prevented Brain from seeing a meteor shower in person.

programme.title: Arthur: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself
programme.desc: When Ms. Morgan announces they'll be having a fire drill during preschool, D.W. wants no part of it--it sounds way too scary. Then, the Tibble Twins are better than D.W. at just about everything.
programme.sub-title: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself

programme.title: Arthur: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Tibble/The Secret Guardians
programme.desc: The Tibble Twins start a new business to earn enough money to buy the coveted Krummy Kreepy Kastle. When and friends stumble upon a beautiful woodland oasis right by their homes, they vow to tell no one and keep it as their secret spot.
programme.sub-title: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Tibble/The Secret Guardians

programme.title: Arthur: D.W., The Picky Eater/Buster And The Daredevils
programme.desc: It's wrong to call D.W. a picky eater. The only things she won't eat are vegetables, fish, fruit, and meat. Then, Arthur and Buster meet two really cool kids and, naturally, are utterly dazzled. How far will Buster go to be cool?
programme.sub-title: D.W., The Picky Eater/Buster And The Daredevils

programme.title: Arthur: Francine Redecorates/Arthur The Loser
programme.desc: Francine and Catherine are very different, but it’s no fun if you're two sisters sharing the same room. Then, there's only one thing in life Arthur really wants—to win! But he just can't stop losing. Is it really so wrong to cheat a little?

programme.title: Arthur: The Election/Francine Goes To War
programme.desc: There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: The series begins before WWI when military commanders struggled to understand what uses aviation might have. The Wright Brothers had been the first to fly a powered aircraft in controlled flight in 1903, but even by 1914 aircraft were still underpowered.
programme.sub-title: Useless for the Purposes of War

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: The 1920s and 30s were uncertain times for the RAF as well as all other armed services. With peace came cuts in spending on new aircraft development.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: By the end of the war the RAF had aircraft that could escort bombers to targets deep inside Germany and back. With the Gloster Meteor, the RAF had also entered the ‘Jet Age’. Aircraft like the Hawker Hunter and F-86 Sabre took the RAF supersonic.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: By the end of the First World War the RAF had bombers that could fly to Berlin and back. For the first time in a thousand years British civilians found themselves under direct attack - by Zeppelin airships and Gotha bombers.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: The RAF’s maritime role is often overlooked. Between the wars the RAF operated elegant flying boats to patrol the far flung corners of the Empire.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: After the war, RAF transports helped keep Berliners alive during the Soviet blockade of the city in 1948/49. As well as flying round-the-clock operations into the airport, Sunderland flying boats delivered supplies by landing on Lake Havel near the city.

programme.title: RAF: The Royal Air Force: Battle for the Skies

programme.title: South Park: Free Willzyx
programme.desc: Free Willzyx: The boys are tricked into believing the killer whale at Sea Park is from the moon. How will Timmy's wheelchair, the Russian government and their skateboards help to free him? (S9, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Bloody Mary: Randy is arrested for drunk driving and must attend AA, where he is told he is powerless to control himself. Maybe the bleeding Virgin Mary statue can perform a miracle or two? (S9, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of Chef
programme.desc: The Return of Chef: The boys notice that Chef is acting weird after returning from the 'The Super Adventure Club'. Why is he trying to seduce them? Can a trip to a strip joint help? (S10, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Smug Alert!
programme.desc: Smug Alert: Kyle's father buys a new hybrid car but it's not long before his smug levels reach ridiculous levels - must be time to move to San Fran! How will Cartman deal with no Kyle? (S10, E02)

programme.title: South Park: A Million Little Fibers
programme.desc: A Million Little Fibers: Towlie writes his memoirs and it's not long before he's invited onto The Oprah Winfrey Show. (S10, E05)

programme.title: South Park: ManBearPig
programme.desc: ManBearPig: Ex U.S. Vice President Al Gore visits South Park Elementary and warns the pupils about ManBearPig, a monster which is "half man, half bear and half pig" - you can't be "cereal"! (S10, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Tsst: Cartman's mum realizes she can no longer control him, so attempts to get help from various reality TV experts. Only when she recruits the "Dog Whisperer" do results start to happen. (S10, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Make Love, Not Warcraft: The boys are all shades of mad when a 'griefer' repeatedly kills them in an online game. Some serious training is in order so they can defeat him and play the game! (S10, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Mystery of the Urinal Deuce
programme.desc: Mystery of The Urinal Deuce: Someone defecates in a urinal at school! Cartman rants that it's a conspiracy "like 9/11!" The entire town think so too! Time for a trip to the White House. (S10, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Miss Teacher Bangs a Boy
programme.desc: Miss Teacher Bangs A Boy: Power goes to Cartman's head when he becomes "Dawg the Hallway Monitor". Meanwhile, Kyle is shocked to discover his little brother Ike and his teacher are at "it"! (S10, E10)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Miss Teacher Bangs a Boy

programme.title: A Haunting: When The Lights Go Out
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits – one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: A Haunting: Haunted Victorian
programme.desc: After moving in their dream home, Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero begin to experience strange occurrences; mysterious footsteps and unexplained noises. Lillian is physically attacked while sleeping and the couple tries to escape, but is it too late?

programme.title: A Haunting: Mother's Terror
programme.desc: When Jeanette's firefighter husband dies in the line of duty, she moves her daughters to a rustic hamlet in Long Island to start anew. Shortly after moving in, an evil entity lashes out at her daughter, Jeanette refuses to quit without a fight.

programme.title: A Haunting: Fear House
programme.desc: Steven LaChance begins to experience strange things inside his house.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghostly Voices
programme.desc: Angelina Balistreri believes her home is haunted by a harmless ghost, while her husband, Emiliano, is skeptical of the paranormal. They call in a priest and medium who makes contact with a troubled ghost and helps him cross over and find peace.

programme.title: A Haunting: Provoking Evil
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis’ séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Uninvited
programme.desc: Meriden, Connecticut natives Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic restaurant, thinking it will be an adventure to operate an establishment so much a part of their youth. Little do they know their experience is about to turn into their worst nightmare.

programme.title: A Haunting: Face Of Evil
programme.desc: Joy, a working mother of three, assumes a girl's weekend at a haunted plantation will be a pleasant change of pace. But after she returns, her youngest child's sleep is shattered by the ominous presence of a dark phantom.

programme.title: A Haunting: Monster in the Apartment
programme.desc: A ghost attacks Morgan Knudsen in order to drive her out and get to her friend Bob.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Diabolical
programme.desc: A session with a Ouija board transforms Marie’s home into a portal for the diabolical.

programme.title: A Haunting: Demon's Lair
programme.desc: For years, the Cranmer family thought their historic Pittsburgh dream home was haunted by a harmless ghost. But, when the activity grows violent, they fight back with the only weapon they have, prayer; culminating with an exorcism of the house.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Lake Club Horror
programme.desc: The Lake Club is transformed into a rock n roll nightclub with mysterious happenings.

programme.title: A Haunting: House of the Dead
programme.desc: Unseen intruders attack 10-year-old Billy Bean. He struggles to learn the secrets of the house.

programme.title: A Haunting: Shape Of Evil
programme.desc: Jay Yaple persuades his wife that Enfield, CT, is the perfect place for them. After a series of unexplained events, Jay discovers the house has a dark history of mysterious deaths. Anyone who attempts to come to their aid is driven away by the demon.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Possessed
programme.desc: Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor for ten years, has a run in with a demonic force.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghost Fury
programme.desc: Shortly after Alicia and Scott Cain move into a farmhouse in the quiet Ohio countryside, they learn their home was the site of a brutal murder decades earlier. Plagued by the ghosts of this horrific event, they call in the Fourman Brothers to investigate.

programme.title: A Haunting: A Haunting in Ireland
programme.desc: The Fahey family’s new addition stirs up psychic energy of a crime committed years ago.

programme.title: A Haunting: Where Evil Lurks
programme.desc: Soon after the Shea family moves into their new home, eerie noises and ghostly voices begin.

programme.title: Born to Kill?
programme.desc: In 1989, Allan Legere went on a brutal crime spree in Canada, committing assault, rape, arson and murder.

programme.title: Born to Kill?
programme.desc: Gripping documentary examining the vicious crimes of Charles Starkweather, an American spree killer who murdered 11 people in the late 50s during a deadly road trip with his young lover.

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: JAG: Return of Mimmy Blackhorse
programme.desc: An Army forensic pathologist joins forces with Harm, Mac, Bud and Harriet as they try to verify that newly unearthed human remains are those of a heroic Navajo "code-talker" who had been missing since WWII.

programme.title: JAG: The Imposter
programme.desc: Harm is held captive by Palmer, a renegade government agent with whom he had crossed swords a few months ago. While Palmer prepares a life mask so he can pass for Harm, he explains his plans to assassinate the key witness in the trial.

programme.title: JAG: To Russia With Love
programme.desc: With evidence that his missing father could still be alive in, Harm convinces the Admiral to give him time off so he can go to Russia. In Moscow, they are questioned by Mark Falcon, the KGB agent who had stolen a list of POW's earlier from Harm.

programme.title: JAG: Gypsy Eyes
programme.desc: Unable to lose the pursuing Russian fighters, Harm's and Mac’s hijacked Mig is shot out of the sky over Siberia.

programme.title: JAG: Act of Terror
programme.desc: When Arab terrorists attach a mine to a US Navy warship in an attempt to sink it, Marine guards are able to kill one and capture the other, even after the mine explodes, killing two sailors.

programme.title: JAG: The Black Jet
programme.desc: Harm and Mac are sent to Teheran, Iran to represent a Navy flier whose Stealth jet crashed in Iran due to a major mechanical failure.

programme.title: JAG: Silent Service
programme.desc: Mac and Harm are having trouble relating...a result of working together under stress for so long.

programme.title: JAG: King of the Greenie Board
programme.desc: Harm is now a Tomcat division commander aboard the carrier USS Patrick Henry that is patrolling the Mediterranean near Yugoslavia.

programme.title: JAG: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: The Russians are furious over the killing of their peacekeepers and the Navy sends Mac, Brumby, and Roberts to the Patrick Henry to conduct the court-martial of Lt. Buxton.

programme.title: JAG: True Calling
programme.desc: When a petty officer smuggles a pregnant Serbian woman aboard the carrier in order to save her from a vengeful fiancée, he's arrested and scheduled to be court-martialed.

programme.title: JAG: Psychic Warrior
programme.desc: When a Navy research project involving ESP and psychic phenomenon goes awry, resulting in the death of one of the research subjects, the Admiral in charge is court-martialed.

programme.title: JAG: Rouge
programme.desc: As the lowest ranking lawyer at JAG, Bud is assigned to accompany Raglan, a former Special Forces operative who is hired by the Pentagon to test security at military bases.

programme.title: JAG: Mishap
programme.desc: "Skates", Harm's RIO when he was aboard the USS Patrick Henry, was the Landing Safety Officer in charge of the deck when a Tomcat crashes while making an emergency landing.

programme.title: JAG: Into the Breach
programme.desc: Harm and Mac agree to help guide young student "attorneys" at Iron Forge Naval Academy, a prep school for the US Naval Academy, as they conduct a mock trial.

programme.title: JAG: Boomerang (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hostilities between Harm and Brumby escalate both in and out of the courtroom and it takes Chegwidden, with Brumby's CO's approval to get them to deal with their anger

programme.title: JAG: People V. Gunny
programme.desc: Gunny is charged with gay-bashing following an off duty altercation outside a gay bar.

programme.title: JAG: The Bridge At Kang So Ri
programme.desc: Harm and Mac board a plane bound for Korea to investigate charges that GI's shot and killed civilians during the Korean War.
programme.sub-title: The Bridge At Kang So Ri

programme.title: JAG: Drop Zone
programme.desc: Mac is prosecuting a SEAL jumpmaster charged with causing the death of one of his men during a parachute insertion exercise.

programme.title: JAG: Real Deal Seal
programme.desc: Medal of Honor Navy SEAL Lt. Curtis Rivers is court-martialed for punching a Congressional candidate who claims to be a Navy SEAL.

programme.title: JAG: Overdue And Presumed Lost
programme.desc: A salvage company tries to claim rights to the wreckage of the USS Dolphin, a WW2 submarine that was lost the day before the attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A family gets a huge scare when a fleeing suspect finds his way into their house. Police sort out a chaotic argument between two childhood friends. A woman in a suspicious vehicle plays fast and loose with the truth.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Officers apprehend an individual with a saw-like knife. A man accused of auto theft claims his girlfriend allowed him to borrow her wheels. Chiquita the chihuahua helps its owner through hard times.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Stop Sticks are used to end the pursuit of a man that Deputies have previously arrested. Two ghost guns are recovered during a traffic stop. Sisters argue over access to their elderly mother.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A motorcycle with no license plate crashes while fleeing from Deputies. A woman driving a car with no windshield blames her ex-boyfriend. A gun is found hidden in a seat during a traffic stop.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Deputies gradually get to the bottom of a possible stolen vehicle. A woman asks the police to help her make a clean break from bad habits. A single woman tries to plan a date with an online suitor, but the night quickly goes awry.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A driver foot bails from a still-rolling van and hides nearby. A teen on a dirt bike refuses to stop for Deputies. A man attempts to run from a traffic stop but gets hung up on a fence.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A man with a knife resists as a hotel clerk cheers on Officers. A man protests the legality of a stop but finally admits why he argued with Officers. A passenger becomes emotional when meth is found.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A man receives an enormous break due to public health concerns. Officers are doubtful when two friends claim they were unaware of each other’s actions. Police pull over a car full of people who know very little about themselves.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Police pursue a driver and his wife in a high-speed chase, a paranoid man vandalizes his roommate's car, and a shoplifter can't keep her story straight.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A suspect is apprehended after trying to evade arrest, a convicted felon is detained when police make some illegal discoveries in his van, and deputies seize a repeat offender.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Meat Wars
programme.desc: Audrey drags Jen to a Bon Jovi concert to prove that she's still young and fun, leaving Jeff and Adam at home. Russell finds a phone number in his pocket and asks Timmy to investigate.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Goodbye Dolly
programme.desc: Audrey tries to prepare for motherhood by continuing to repair a doll that she keeps damaging. Meanwhile, Jeff questions whether the very pregnant Brenda should be dating anymore, and Adam tries to convince Jennifer that he is a manly man.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Audrey's Shower
programme.desc: Jen puts the wrong date on the invitations to Audrey's baby shower, Jeff likes Audrey's maternity clothes, and Russell gives up women.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Liz Moves In
programme.desc: Liz temporarily moves in with Jeff and Audrey. Jeff isn't happy with the new guest, but changes his mind when he discovers Liz consistently takes his side against Audrey.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Taking Names
programme.desc: Jeff and Audrey realize that the names on their baby list are also the names of women that Russell has slept with. Adam becomes a cycling enthusiast after Jennifer suggests they start riding bikes in the park.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Feeling lonely after her cat dies, Liz looks for a sperm donor. When Timmy's intellect and innocence don't attract his crush, he tries his hand at playing 'big dog.' Adam rips the vintage wedding dress that Jennifer's family sent her.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Cupcake
programme.desc: Russell gets jealous when Timmy manages to outshine him at his own pick-up game. Adam and Jennifer leave pot-laced cupcakes on the kitchen counter, and an unaware Jeff eats one.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Fountain Of Youth
programme.desc: After meeting up with college friends who are no longer into partying, Jeff and Audrey set out to prove that even with a baby on the way, they can still have fun. Meanwhile, Timmy attempts to find Russell's compassionate side.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Baby Talk
programme.desc: When Audrey bonds with their unborn baby by reading her stories, a paranoid Jeff believes that she is trying to form an alliance against him. Meanwhile, Russell steals an article that Timmy wrote.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Role Play
programme.desc: Jeff promises to take Audrey to an upmarket and very popular restaurant but forgets to book a table. Determined to dine there, he hatches a plan to get in by claiming that a last-minute reservation is needed for a celebrity.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Catering
programme.desc: Brenda enlists Jeff and Audrey's help when she does the catering for an event at Columbia University. While waitressing, Audrey tries to fit in with the guests, only to discover that they are more impressed with Jeff's bartending skills.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Cooking Class
programme.desc: The couples attempt to enjoy recreational cooking classes together, but Jeff and Adam can't keep their competitive nature out of the kitchen. Russell doesn't notice how disturbingly similar his new girlfriend is to Timmy.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Unpleasant Surprises
programme.desc: When Jennifer learns that the guys have nothing planned for Adam's last weekend as a bachelor, she plans a party weekend. Things don't go as planned, however, so Jeff, Russell, and Timmy must improvise.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Timmy Quits
programme.desc: Audrey has always had suspicions that Jeff's old college friend Heidi harbours romantic feelings for him, so Jeff invites Heidi over to prove that this was never the case.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: A Wee Problem
programme.desc: Jeff does his best to make a heavily pregnant Brenda laugh when he discovers that she has a `wee problem' due to her condition, but his antics cause her waters to break. Meanwhile, Adam annoys Audrey with his non-stop chatter during a spa visit.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: 100th
programme.desc: Brenda goes into labor on Jen and Adam's wedding day, but Jeff has reservations about being in the delivery room. Adam persuades Jen to make some alternative arrangements for their marriage ceremony.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Rules of Engagement: Pilot
programme.desc: Adam and Jennifer are a 20-something couple who have gotten engaged and moving in together after just seven months of dating. Meanwhile, their neighbors Jeff and Audrey who have been married for twelve years try to set a good example.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Birthday Deal
programme.desc: Though he's unhappy that Audrey spent more than usual for his birthday party, Jeff wants to stay on her good side to ensure he gets his yearly birthday deal. Though Jeff won't reveal the 'deal.'

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Young and the Restless
programme.desc: After Adam has too many restless nights sleeping in Jennifer’s small bed, he brings home the bed he shared with his ex-girlfriend which causes a fight and leads them tossing out all memories of past relationships.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: Jennifer tries to help Jeff’s sore neck with a massage until the situation between them becomes uncomfortable and upsets Audrey. Meanwhile, Russell brings Adam along to help him fight off a school yard bully so Russell can get close to the teacher.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Kids
programme.desc: Adam and Jennifer’s plans for a romantic weekend fall apart after they argue about their different feelings toward careers, finances, and kids. Meanwhile, Audrey is having second thoughts about why she and Jeff have waited so long to have children.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Game on
programme.desc: After Adam buys an expensive video-game console, Jennifer makes him promise to discuss major purchases first, but Russell interferes and makes Adam question the agreement.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Jeff's Wooby

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Payback
programme.desc: A mysterious death by poisoning creates questions about the safety of portal technology. When a Taelon is killed in the same manner, the investigation leads to a very smart scientist that even the Resistance was scared to work with.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Paul Chandler plots an attack on the Taelon Embassy in DC with the ship he stole from Lili. He begs her to join him in beginning an all out war.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Volunteers
programme.desc: A group of Resistance capture a volunteer from a Taelon program for youth. Liam decides they may learn valuable information from her. They also decide to send in one of their own as a volunteer to see what the program is teaching.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Bliss
programme.desc: Lili is given a psychotropic drug called "bliss" via a Taelon device. They discover it is widespread. With an instantly strong addictive property, the addicts are dying within 48 hours. The investigation leads Liam and Sandoval to Ireland.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Highjacked
programme.desc: With a reporter on board, the Taelon mother ship is highjacked into interdimensional space. Liam is the prime suspect, causing an even bigger rift between Da'an and Zo'or. As the ship floats, lost in space, they must find the real culprit.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Defector
programme.desc: A shuttle crashes on a beach after being pursued by a second Taelon piloted shuttle. When Liam locates the survivor (a Taelon called Belleye), he claims to want to help the Resistance take back Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Heroes and Heartbreak
programme.desc: Augur is recruited by a Taelon weapons project, but the others are worried about his involvement. When the project is launched earlier than originally planned to fight a Jiridian fleet, the Earth is in danger.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A Jiridian probe headed for Earth is shot down by the Taelon Embassy and crashes outside of D.C. Liam recovers the probe, but he, Augur, and Julia are captured by another underground resistance movement led by the real Colonel Liam Kincaid.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crossfire
programme.desc: As the election draws near, Liam believes Zo'or is trying to have Jonathan Doors murdered. The Resistance worries that an attack is imminent at the final debate. Julia mobilizes a group to protect Doors against Liam's wishes.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crackdown
programme.desc: An unknown woman saves Augur and Liam from the raids on the Resistance. Lili sabotages the mother ship, but Zo'or stops its total destruction. Lili is reportedly dead. The investigation on the President's shooter continues.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Vanished
programme.desc: Some who were detained during the Resistance sweep have not reappeared after their release. Lili is taken to a lab run by Sandoval and implanted. Renee tries to help Liam find the missing people.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Emancipation
programme.desc: A group posing as volunteers attacks using a stolen skrill prototype that does not require an implant to control. It is discovered that the skrill queen is also missing. The investigation leads to a resistance group called Black Wednesday.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: A joint Doors International/Taelon venture creates a machine that allows people to vividly relive a memory, but Liam suspects a back alley version of the device is leading to the death of some users.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Once and Future World
programme.desc: Artifacts believed to be Taelon are found in South America. Renee and Liam try to beat Sandoval to the source to determine the importance of the found pieces.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Thicker than Blood
programme.desc: An old business partner of Augur's is hired by Da'an to get information about the Resistance, resulting in the death of many members. Meanwhile, Sandoval finds out he has a life threatening blood disorder.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: A Little Bit of Heaven
programme.desc: Liam and Renee investigate a dead pregnant woman missing her fetus. They discover a town that Da'an helped after a nuclear meltdown and a suspicious brother and sister who were part of an early experiment to combine human and Taelon DNA.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Pad'ar
programme.desc: Pad'ar is a fierce battle game where spectators can connect via a "jack patch" that Liam suspects is causing neurological damage to users. When a Pad'ar warrior dies, it raises even more questions about the safety.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: In Memory
programme.desc: Lili wakes up, supposedly on Earth after a coma, and is told the Jaridians have come and conquered the Taelons. She remembers Sandoval telling her she no longer has and Earth-based physiology and believes things are not as they seem.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Cloister
programme.desc: Zo'or and Da'an travel to a cloister for an energy sharing ceremony, but one of the sisters is killed and everyone is a suspect.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Interview
programme.desc: Zo'or agrees to do a live television interview to try to endear himself to humans, but the show's producer has an ulterior motive in getting him in front of a camera.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: The shuttle Liam and Zo'or are in crashes over wilderness, but survive in safety bubbles. The people they meet live off the earth and know nothing of the Taelons. However, Zo'or is injured and missing a Synod meeting on the mother ship.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Gimp
programme.desc: While investigating a series of muggings of disabled persons, Cagney (Sharon Gless) gets a first-hand look at the problems they face and becomes romantically involved with a man (guest star James Stacy) who is handicapped and advocating for change.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Family Connections
programme.desc: Cagney has to rush to Lacey's side at the hospital, hoping that she can make it before the baby is delivered. Being around Lacey and her family makes Cagney have second thoughts about her life as a singleton. Cagney's father has a new girlfriend.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Post Partum
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes involved in a case where a West Point cadet is charged with possession of cocaine and is refusing to help himself due to his honor code. Meanwhile, Lacey's (Tyne Daly) father pays her a visit after a 30-year absence.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Man Who Shot Trotsky
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) receive a second opportunity to nail a notorious narcotics dealer as Petrie (Carl Lumbly) and Isbecki (Martin Kove) go 'off-Broadway' to pursue a murder case. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Exit Stage Center (S04E19)
programme.desc: When a famous actress dies, the first assumption is suicide. However, as Cagney and Lacey investigate, they soon discover that she was murdered and everyone in the cast and crew of the play she was in has a probable motive for killing her.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Capitalism
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the murder of a prominent and well-respected Cambodian immigrant lawyer and discover his business might not be as it appears. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Extradition
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are sent to Los Angeles to extradite an old 'perp' as Cagney meets her brother Brian's (guest star David Ackroyd) family for the first time in 12 years. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: A Safe Place
programme.desc: When a vial of plutonium is stolen from a scientist, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) run up against government barriers trying to locate the lethal radioactive material before the thief becomes terminally ill.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Model Citizen
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the gangland-style murder of a highly respected union leader, making everyone question why a man with a spotless record would be murdered in the first place. Also starring Al Waxman.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Parting Shots
programme.desc: Detective Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) is gunned down in front of his fellow detectives who must find the killer while coming to grips with the loss of their colleague and the danger of their jobs. Starring Sharon Gless and Tyne Daly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: You Call This Plainclothes?
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place involving prostitutes, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover in the hopes of finding who keeps killing the women. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown
programme.desc: A Chinatown robbery brings Cagney's retired father back on the beat to show his daughter how to properly conduct an investigation. Guest starring Dick O'Neill as Charlie Cagney. Tyne Daly, Meg Foster, Al Waxman, and Carl Lumbly star.
programme.sub-title: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beyond The Golden Door
programme.desc: In the hopes of finding a missing child, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover as workers in the garment industry and end up helping an undocumented worker from Guatemala find her sister's murderer.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Suffer The Children
programme.desc: Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) become involved in an investigation of child abuse and possible murder when they rescue a four-year-old child from a window ledge. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Better Than Equal
programme.desc: Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) must ignore their feminist sentiments when they are assigned to protect the life of ERA critic, Helen Granger (guest star Julie Adams), who is being harassed by a caller who is threatening her life.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Street Scene
programme.desc: After an elderly man (guest star George Petrie) is involved with the death of a gang member, Cagney and Lacey are accused of racial prejudice as they investigate what happened. The truth is finally revealed with the help of the victim's brother.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Witness To An Incident

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert, Ralph, Melissa, and the gang secretly plan a surprise for Cyril Sneer. When Cyril notices odd behavior, he grows paranoid and believes the Raccoons are plotting against him, leading him to take drastic and ridiculous measures to defend himself.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert sets out to climb Evergreen Mountain alone to prove his independence. Meanwhile, Cyril Sneer plots to stop him to keep a hidden family secret safe. As Bert faces danger and doubt, he must rely on courage and determination to succeed.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Ralph take Cedric camping at their childhood fort, but to join their club, Cedric must spend the night in a haunted house alone. As fear sets in, Cedric discovers inner bravery while the others anxiously wait to see if he succeeds.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril and Mammoth Motors plan to build a factory that will harm the forest. To stop him, Bert and his friends create a solar-powered car to race against Cyril’s Sneermobile, with the future of Evergreen Forest depending on the outcome.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Feeling unappreciated, Cedric runs away and stays with the Raccoons. At the same time, Julie and Tommy run away but become lost in the forest. The gang must find them quickly while helping Cedric deal with his feelings about his father.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert, Cedric, and Broo discover a treasure map and begin searching the forest for hidden riches. When Cyril learns of their quest, he schemes to claim the treasure for himself, turning the search into a race filled with tricks and surprises.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Ralph and Cedric become trapped in Cyril Sneer’s new vault, which is filled with dangerous traps. Bert, Melissa, and Broo attempt a daring rescue, and even Cyril must help as they work together to escape before it is too late.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Ralph receives a job offer in the city, and Ranger Dan is given a similar chance. Bert worries the group will split apart and be unable to stop Cyril’s plans, forcing everyone to decide whether to follow opportunity or stay together.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: After telling too many wild stories, Bert is no longer believed when he discovers Cyril plans to pave the forest into a parking lot. With no one trusting him, Bert must find proof quickly before Cyril carries out his destructive plan.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: When Cedric and Sophia hear that royalty will visit Evergreen Forest, Bert dreams of becoming a knight. Meanwhile, Cyril wants knighthood for power, leading both into humorous efforts to impress the royal visitors during their stay.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril schemes to buy the Evergreen Standard by cutting off its supplies with help from Mr. Knox, who demands payment in gold. Bert tries to save the paper by finding a way to secure resources, leading to a risky plan to outsmart Cyril.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A pro baseball team visits Evergreen Forest and seeks a new player. Bert and Cedric both compete for the spot, straining their friendship as rivalry grows. In the end, they must decide what matters more, success or their bond.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril offers Bert a deal to become the face of his new cologne line. Tempted by fame and money, Bert considers the offer, but soon realizes the cost of endorsing Cyril’s schemes and must choose between integrity and success.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril panics when his betrayed partner Karl Snarl returns for revenge. Meanwhile, Bert discovers an old helicopter, and Melissa must overcome her fear of heights to help save her friends during a dangerous confrontation.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: After losing power due to unpaid bills, Cyril plans to build a dam to control energy in the forest. Meanwhile, Bert and Cedric stay with Aunt Gertie, whose strict ways test their patience while bigger trouble brews outside.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cousin Bentley visits the Raccoons, bringing his usual quirks along. Meanwhile, Cyril seeks to regain his youth using a questionable potion, leading to chaos as his reckless attempt causes unexpected and humorous consequences.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Melissa explore echo caverns and discover strange cave art. Cyril, seeing profit potential, enters the art world and drives up prices. The gang must decide whether art is about value or meaning as greed takes over.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Believing Cyril is dying, Bert spends his savings on a tribute monument. When Cyril learns he is fine, he exploits the situation to sabotage the Evergreen Standard, forcing Bert to recover from his costly mistake quickly.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Cedric meet a hermit living in a swamp rumored to hold oil. Cyril attempts to buy the land, threatening the hermit’s home. The gang must protect the swamp and prove its worth beyond the profit Cyril seeks.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A misunderstanding leads everyone to believe Cyril is marrying Lady Baden-Baden. Cedric questions his past while Mr. Knox hides his feelings for her. As confusion grows, truths come out and relationships are tested.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: The pigs invent a time machine, which Cyril uses to alter past events for personal gain. However, his meddling causes chaos in the present, forcing the gang to fix the timeline before things spiral completely out of control.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril borrows a priceless diamond for a film, but it disappears. Bert investigates while Cyril tries to hide the loss from Lady Baden-Baden and Mr. Knox, leading to a frantic search filled with misdirection and secrets.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Adventurer Sir Malcolm invites Bert on an expedition, which Cyril secretly funds for treasure. As Bert seeks adventure and discovery, Cyril’s greed threatens the mission, putting everyone in danger along the way.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril’s failing chip business leads him to stage a fake contest to boost sales. Bert gets caught up and wastes money, realizing too late it’s a scam. The gang must expose the truth before others are tricked as well.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Daredevil biker Bix arrives and impresses Bert, but his reckless actions cause trouble that Cedric gets blamed for. Bert must recognize the difference between excitement and responsibility before friendships are damaged.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A supposed lake monster draws tourists to Evergreen Forest. Cyril exploits the craze by selling merchandise, while Bert and Melissa investigate the truth behind the sightings and reveal what is really going on.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: The pigs’ mother visits, believing her sons are wealthy. To maintain the lie, they scramble to impress her while hiding the truth. Meanwhile, Cyril faces pressure as their deception spirals out of control.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Melissa captures heroic photos of Snag and gains media attention. As fame grows, Snag is offered a TV role, but must decide if he wants the spotlight or a simpler life with his friends in the forest.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cedric attends school to build confidence but returns overly strict and changed. His new personality causes friction, and both Cyril and the Raccoons must help Cedric rediscover his true self before he loses his identity.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert finds a hidden steam train in the forest, while Cyril learns it holds a fortune. Both race to locate it first, leading to a chase where history, greed, and adventure collide deep within Evergreen Forest.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bentley runs away during a personal crisis and hides at the fort. Meanwhile, Cyril’s new security system malfunctions, trapping him inside his mansion. Both situations spiral until help arrives from unexpected places.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Ralph’s nomination boosts his ego, causing him to act arrogantly at the paper. Meanwhile, Cyril seeks an award but faces setbacks. Both must learn humility as their ambitions begin to damage what they value most.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A man claiming to be Cyril’s brother arrives for an inheritance. Bert suspects deception and investigates. As tensions rise, the truth about Simon’s identity is revealed, forcing Cyril to confront his past.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril joins a game show where he must identify voices from his past. As pressure mounts, mistakes threaten his chances, and unexpected voices complicate matters, turning the challenge into a chaotic ordeal.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril reunites with an old friend who inspires him musically. Given another chance to perform, Cyril must overcome pride and doubt while reconnecting with a part of himself he had long forgotten.

programme.desc: Kendall y Jo ayudan a Carlos a encontrar una novia y Logan flirtea con una chica nueva mientras intenta aclarar qué siente por Camille. James quiere ayudar a Katie a acercarse a un chico que le gusta pero acabará portándose como un padre protector.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Grupo De Chicas
programme.desc: Gustavo funda un grupo pop solo de chicas, lo que desencadenará los celos de los chicos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Gran fiesta en la playa
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen la oportunidad de pasar un día en la casa de la playa de Griffin e invitan a todos sus amigos de Palm Woods. Carlos y Logan buscan un tesoro escondido y James se enamora de una chica, de la que sospecha es una sirena.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Realidad
programme.desc: Griffin filma la vida de los chicos para un programa de telerealidad.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Mamá
programme.desc: La madre de James, apodada la 'la Estee Lauder del Medioeste' por su existosa línea de cosméticos, llega a Palm Woods para llevarse a James a casa y prepararlo para que el chico asuma el control de la compañía familiar.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Ruptura
programme.desc: Kendall y Jo deben asumir el futuro de su relación cuando la chica consigue un gran papel en una superproducción que se va a rodar en el extranjero durante tres años.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Proyecto Verde
programme.desc: Una competición de clase para convertir Palm Woods en un entorno más ecológico acaba en desastre.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Boda
programme.desc: El romance de cuento de hadas de James con una princesa extranjera acaba rápidamente en una misión de fuga cuando el chico, inadvertidamente, le propone matrimonio a la princesa. Sus amigos deberán liberarlo antes de que se celebre una boda real.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Rey Del Baile
programme.desc: Se acerca el baile anual del colegio de Palm Woods y Carlos, James, Logan y Kendall están decididos, cueste lo que cueste, a obtener el título de rey del baile.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Concurso
programme.desc: Una revista para adolescentes organiza el concurso 'Gana una cita con BTR' y las cuatro afortunadas ganadoras, cada una con sus propios problemas, serán una pesadilla para los muchachos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Roquera
programme.desc: Lucy, una roquera muy guay de 18 años, se muda a Palm Woods e inmediatamente se lleva de calle a los chicos de BTR. Carlos y James se proponen cada uno salir con ella mientras Kendall se afana por demostrar que BTR también puede rocanrolear.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Huelga
programme.desc: BTR se niega a grabar su segundo álbum después de la dureza con la que Gustavo los ha tratado. La huelga se convierte en una batalla de voluntades entre el denonado grupo y su testarudo productor.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Sencillo
programme.desc: Mientras Gustavo sufre componiendo el siguiente éxito del grupo, los chicos intentan animar al desconsolado Kendall después de su ruptura con Jo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Superhéroes
programme.desc: Hawk ha vuelto y tiene un nuevo plan diabólico para hundir a Big Time Rush. Planea robar las nuevas pistas de BTR y apropiárselas como si fueran suyas.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Secreto
programme.desc: Hay secretos en Palm Woods. Kendall y Camille pasan mucho tiempo juntos, lo que levanta las sospechas de Logan. James revela que nunca le dijo a Carlos que Heather Fox, la chica del campamento que le gustaba a Carlos, también estaba por él.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Mudanza
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen una gran pelea y deciden separarse. James se retira a un apartamento lujoso, Logan se marcha a vivir a una casa de la playa, Carlos se construye una casa de cartón y Kendall deberá arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Entrevista
programme.desc: Big Time Rush acaba de publicar su segundo álbum y los chicos son entrevistados para un programa musical donde responderán preguntas y revelan su vida dentro y fuera de Big Time Rush.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Lío entre bastidores
programme.desc: Es la última parada en la gira mundial de BTR e iremos entre bambalinas para ver toda la locura que sucede detrás del escenario. Veremos cómo los chicos se preparan para el concierto y lidian con los problemas que surgen.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes retornos
programme.desc: Los chicos regresan de su gira mundial a Palm Woods siendo ya famosos, aunque lo que ellos quieren ahora es descansar y ligar. Griffin intenta sobornar a Carlos para que escoja su canción favorita para la próxima entrevista en la radio de los chicos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran Bel Air
programme.desc: BTR son demasiado famosos para vivir en Palm Woods, de modo que Gustavo traslada al grupo a Bel Air. Sin embargo, las reglas que acompañan a una vida de lujo no van con los chicos y estos planean su gran escapada para volver a Palm Woods.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran cita doble
programme.desc: El amor está en el aire en Palm Woods. James ayuda a Carlos con su cita con una de las Jennifers, Kendall irá a cenar a casa de los padres de Lucy y Logan acepta una cita a ciegas para poder espiar a Camille con Jett.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes subproductos
programme.desc: Griffin pretende colocar una línea de productos de marca BTR en Selmart pero a los chicos no les gustan nada los productos y tomarán cartas en el asunto saboteando la reunión, con lo que conseguirán que se prohiba su música en la cadena Selmart.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran sorpresa
programme.desc: Kendall y Lucy están a punto de besarse por primera vez pero aparece Beau, el guapo ex de Lucy con la intención de reconquistarla. Griffin recluta a Logan y a Carlos para una operación de espionaje corporativo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran decisión
programme.desc: Kendall está listo para pedirle salir a Lucy pero aparece Jo inesperadamente y Kendall tendrá que decidir entre las dos chicas. Mientras tanto, la amistad entre Carlos y James es puesta a prueba.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes canguros
programme.desc: Kendall y Logan deberán ocuparse del nuevo artista de Rocque Records, una leyenda del rock venida a menos, hasta su ingreso en el panteón de la fama del rocanrol esa noche. James y Carlos estarán haciendo de niñeras de Katie.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran acampada
programme.desc: Los chicos quieren ir de acampada pero Gustavo veta la idea porque es peligroso. A cambio, usan sus conexiones para acampar en un estudio de sonido pero la cosa se tuerce cuando los chicos empiezan a hacer el bruto.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran rescate
programme.desc: Kendall y Logan se presentan voluntarios en un refugio canino y acaban adoptando a 12 perros pero un inspector de sanidad muy ladino los vigila. El amor entre Carlos y Jennifer asquea a James y las otras Jennifers, quienes intentarán rescatarlos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran fiebre del oro
programme.desc: Kendall le regala a Jo un collar de oro para demostrarle su compromiso pero Camille piensa que Logan se lo ha comprado a ella. Gustavo cuelga un nuevo disco de oro de BTR y Carlos y James se preguntan qué pasaría si lo pusieran en el tocadiscos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes meteduras de pata
programme.desc: Los chicos destruyen por accidente la cinta del nuevo episodio de Big Time Rush que debían entregar a la cadena. Para sustituir el episodio, los chicos deciden hacer un programa de tomas falsas con Stephen Glickman y Clara Bravo como presentadores.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran invasión
programme.desc: ¡BTR tiene que impedir la invasión de los grupos británicos de chicos! Ya que Gustavo está demasiado disperso, los chicos contratan a un agente musical famoso, pero al no ponerse de acuerdo, el grupo se disuelve y la brecha se acentúa en el grupo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran escándalo
programme.desc: Lucy publica su album de venganza contra Kendall con gran éxito. James, desesperado por llamar la atención, difunde el rumor de que va a grabar un duo con Cher Lloyd y Carlos recibe mala prensa al golpear, supuestamente, a una anciana.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes mentiras
programme.desc: Kendall debe impedir que Jo descubra que Lucy ha vuelto a Palm Woods. La mentirijilla de Logan sobre estar enfermo acaba convirtiéndose en una emergencia médica y Carlos y James alegan que se ha producido un robo en Rocque Records.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran bonificación
programme.desc: Gustavo entrega una prima a los chicos por haber trabajado bien pero estos no tardan en tomar malas decisiones sobre el dinero.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Programa de humor basado en los seis pilares que siempre han definido el humor de José Mota: Sketches, Apartes, Musicales, Parodias televisivas y cinematográficas, Imitaciones y Personajes. Con la participación del grupo musical Dvicio.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Amaia Montero participa en José Mota Presenta para compartir con Tomás uno de sus éxitos más recientes. En ‘El ministerio del tiempo’, los agentes habituales están acompañados de Blasa, para cumplir una misión relacionada con el Tratado de Utrecht.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: La cantante Merche, invitada especial de este programa, en el que emulará a Olivia Newton John en el musical '50 sombras de Grease'. En la parodia de los 'Gipsy Kings', Los Chunguitos y Richy Castellanos viajarán a América.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Programa de humor protagonizado por José Mota.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Una entrega en la que se verá la relación del cuñado histórico con Edvard Munch, las aventuras de Tony Folledo en su última etapa y un musical protagonizado por la pareja. Además, una divertida versión de 'Perfectos desconocidos'.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Una entrega en la que se conocerá al cuñado de Darwin y se parodiarán los programas ‘Master Chef’ y ‘Comando Actualidad’. Además, Jacintus XL intentará ligar en Internet.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Bertín Osborne entrevista en “En la tuya o en la mía” a Pedro Almódovar. En 'Planeta Collejas', Antonio Ferreras sufrirá los inconvenientes de esta apuesta televisiva.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Nuevas imitaciones, musicales y personajes, apostando por nuevas formas de contar las situaciones cómicas, más cercanas al humor absurdo y, como siempre, manteniendo su compromiso con la realidad social.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Veremos una parodia muy divertida de ‘En tu casa o en la mía’ en la que Bertín Osborne entrevistará a Miguel Ángel Revilla.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: Sultanes del Sur
programme.desc: Cuatro profesionales atracan un banco en México. Consiguen un botín de 11 millones de dólares, y se van a Buenos Aires para cambiar los dólares por pesos.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres. Pronto se embarcarán en una misión suicida para volar un puente.

programme.title: Junglee: Alma Salvaje
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra vuelve a casa, a la reserva de elefantes de su padre, donde tendrá que luchar contra unos cazadores furtivos.

programme.title: Bienvenido A Hamburgo
programme.desc: En su primera misión en Investigación Criminal, Nick Tschiller descubre un piso usado para explotar a menores. Un violento tiroteo acaba con la muerte de tres miembros del Clan Astan, desatando un peligroso conflicto.

programme.title: El Gran Dolor
programme.desc: Nick Tschiller y Yalcin Guemer siguen enfrentándose al clan Astan. Cuando Nick descubre la implicación de políticos alemanes en sus crímenes, su exmujer y su hija son secuestradas para obligarlo a guardar silencio.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Un mafioso recuerda su ascenso en el Londres de los años sesenta. La ambición y la envidia lo llevan a traicionar a su mentor, Freddie Mays, para convertirse en el gánster más temido de la ciudad.

programme.title: Juerga de mamis
programme.desc: Cuatro madres salen a cenar juntas y terminan viviendo una noche inesperada llena de aventuras.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: Animales en apuros
programme.desc: Después de convertirse en mejores amigos, un castor y un gato emprenden una misión peligrosa para liberar a sus compañeros animales, que fueron secuestrados por extraterrestres.

programme.title: Stubby, un héroe muy especial
programme.desc: La vida del joven militar Robert Conroy cambia cuando encuentra a un pequeño perro en el campamento donde entrena para la guerra. El perro se embarca en la aventura, donde luchará junto a Robert y las tropas francesas antes de hacer historia.

programme.title: Mision Katmandú
programme.desc: Nelly es una detective novata y Simon es un investigador de ciencia que deben trabajar juntos en una loca aventura para probar la existencia del Yeti.

programme.title: Kika Superbruja: El viaje a Mandolán
programme.desc: En esta ocasión veremos cómo Kika tiene problemas para compaginar su vida como bruja con su familia. Será entonces cuando el visir de Mandolán, que quiere convertirse en rey, solicite su ayuda, para acabar con la maldición que se cierne sobre el trono.

programme.title: Kika Superbruja y el Libro de los Hechizos: Kika Superbruja y el Libro de los Hechizos
programme.desc: Kika es una niña normal aunque un poco traviesa y aventurera. Un día, la joven encuentra un antiguo libro de magia, con el que empieza a revivir un sinfín de aventuras. A su lado, le acompaña su fiel aliado Héctor, un pequeño dragón.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Un padre sarcástico (Bernie Mac) tiene mucho que decirle a su hija sobre su prometido blanco (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: El Gruñón
programme.desc: Un arisco anciano choca con su nuera cuando, a consecuencia de una caída, tenga que trasladarse a vivir con la familia de su hijo a Helsinki. Su nuera es una mujer de carrera que no tiene tiempo para perder con un cascarrabias.

programme.title: Mafalda, la película
programme.desc: Los personajes del dibujante argentino Quino nos presentan un divertido largometraje, con el que podemos disfrutar de sus aventuras más alocadas, presentando una visión crítica del mundo de los adultos.

programme.title: Los Padecientes
programme.desc: Un thriller psicológico que gira en torno a una joven mujer que se enfrenta a oscuros secretos familiares, mientras su salud mental y su percepción de la realidad comienzan a desmoronarse.

programme.title: La marca del lobo
programme.desc: Hace diez años, una muchacha presencia el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque y convirtiéndose en algo que los cazadores nunca hallarían: un lobo. Ahora, a pesar de que vive al otro lado del mundo, ella sigue huyendo.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda liderada por Macao Park planea un gran golpe en un casino. Pero sin honor entre ladrones, cada uno trama su propio plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: The Guilty Ones
programme.desc: La hija de BAI fue secuestrada y murió accidentalmente hace diez años, el oficial Chen le prometió atrapar al criminal pero se retiró sin ningún resultado.

programme.title: La marca del lobo
programme.desc: Hace diez años, una muchacha presencia el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque y convirtiéndose en algo que los cazadores nunca hallarían: un lobo. Ahora, a pesar de que vive al otro lado del mundo, ella sigue huyendo.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: Mátalos suavemente
programme.desc: Un sicario es contratado para investigar un robo relacionado con la mafia.

programme.title: Headhunters
programme.desc: Un reclutador corporativo, quien también se dedica a robar arte, planea robar una pintura valiosa del candidato perfecto para un trabajo vacante.

programme.title: María Montez
programme.desc: Era conocida como "La reina del tecnicolor" en Hollywood y Europa, pero a medida que se hacía más famosa, se sentía más vacía. Un startlet que no podía encontrar el amor o la felicidad hasta que fue demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Reset ES
programme.desc: Reset se compone de siete historias independientes dirigidas por Pilar Palomero, Nata Moreno, Alejandro Cortés, Javier Macipe, Ignacio Estaregui, Pablo Aragüés y Gaizka Urresti.

programme.title: El Hilo Rojo
programme.desc: Basada en una leyenda china, esta película romántica narra la historia de dos personas que están predestinadas a encontrarse a través de un hilo rojo invisible, uniendo sus destinos de manera irremediable.

programme.title: Desearas
programme.desc: En un caluroso verano argentino, las hermanas distantes se reencuentran para una boda, reavivando viejos conflictos y deseos prohibidos. Los secretos se desvelan mientras navegan entre deber familiar y anhelo personal en este drama intenso.

programme.title: Sin novedad en el frente
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela homónima del escritor alemán Erich Maria Remarque. Drama antibelicista sobre la gran decepción que sufre un grupo de estudiantes adolescentes que han sido enviados al frente durante la I Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: El Lute II: Mañana seré libre
programme.desc: El Lute escapa de la prisión de El Puerto de Santa María. Lo primero que hace tras su huida es acudir a sus hermanos para pedirles ayuda.

programme.title: El Lute: Camina o revienta
programme.desc: En 1960, una familia de quinquis recorre Extremadura. La vida tan dura que llevan causa la muerte de la madre. El hijo, Eleuterio Sánchez, roba unas gallinas y es condenado a seis meses de cárcel...

programme.title: Todo por un sueño
programme.desc: Suzanne sueña con convertirse en una presentadora estrella de la televisión. No quiere que nada ni nadie se interponga en su camino. Por esa razón intentará eliminar a su marido, que representa un gran obstáculo para su carrera.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: Un amor de verano
programme.desc: Antiguos novios de la infancia fingen ser pareja durante el verano para quitarse de encima a sus abuelas casamenteras.

programme.title: Encuentra el amor en Valentine
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: La fuente de los deseos
programme.desc: La propietaria de una tienda de mascotas de San Francisco se reencuentra con su primer amor y debe resistirse a enamorarse de él por segunda vez.

programme.title: Corazones perdidos
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura sentimental, Marie pierde la Navidad; su madre le envía los adornos de su infancia con milagros.

programme.title: Navidad vuelve a casa
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de su amor de la infancia y su hijo de seis años, ABBEY redescubre su espíritu navideño mientras recrea los adornos hechos a mano por su abuela para la feria navideña anual de su ciudad natal.

programme.title: Espiando a los detectives
programme.desc: Un cinéfilo aficionado al cine negro hasta el extremo prueba de su propia medicina y ve cómo su vida da un vuelco de la mano de una extraña mujer fatal con una gran aventura en mente. A veces el amor supera a la ficción.

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: Recuerdos del corazón
programme.desc: With her husband jailed for Wall Street fraud, Faith leaves her life of luxury behind to return to rural North Carolina and the father and sister she'd left behind.

programme.title: A Second Chance
programme.desc: Maddy Cornel (Emily Morris) es una niña de 12 años cuyo sueño es ser gimnasta profesional, pero su nivel de autoestima y su poca confianza en sí misma suponen una barrera para empezar a conquistar su sueño.

programme.title: Bob Esponja
programme.desc: ¿Quién vive en la piña debajo del mar? ¡Bob Esponja! Sumérgete en Fondo de Bikini para vivir las aventuras más desternillantes con Bob Esponja, Patricio y Calamardo.
