programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Robby wants to convert a 1926 Ford Model T to a far rarer 1914 C Cab. Dan agrees to the plan, but soon has cause to regret it. Anthony buys a 69 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible, but the car of his dreams is an accident waiting to happen.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tom asks Dan to find him a rare 1967 Camaro Convertible with factory AC. But when Dan finds the Unicorn, the car is too good to cut up. Dave wants Dan to build a safe, all stock 1971 Datsun, but the car has been badly damaged by previous restoration work.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Nick challenges Dan to build a 1969 Camaro Pace Car that can beat the fastest Chevelle that FantomWorks has ever built. Pete’s Mustang Convertible was in three different shops, but it arrives with far more problems than anyone was expecting.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Nikkos wants a spectacular 1968 Mustang Fastback resto-mod. The all-metal masterpiece catches the eye of someone who wants it at any cost. Jim and Arlene want to enjoy their 45th anniversary in the same 1969 Firebird they rode in on their wedding day.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and team at Muscle Cars of Texas go under the hood of the 69 Malibu. The 63 Z06 factory race car, you have to see what it takes to make this race car look like it came out of the factory. Tagging and bagging time on the 72 Corvette.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Arnold brings Dan two interlocking projects. He wants FantomWorks to transform his 1946 Ford Panel Wagon into a classic tour-mobile, and he also wants Dan to fix the 1941 Harley Flathead motorcycle that will ride in the back.

programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Lolo Wood försöka undvika roliga fall i 'Flyktmissar', lära känna hundar som är lättpåverkade i 'Härmhundar' och visa varför skyddshjälmar är så viktiga i 'Rakt uppifrån'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt blir Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood varse hur mycket skada en strippstång kan orsaka i 'Pål-itlig skada' och upptäcker sedan att inte alla gillar att bli skrämda i 'Skrämdilsk' innan de avslutar med 'Övergivna faror'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness svingar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood klubbor i 'Sving-ding', kraschar på 'Små landningsbanor' och blir offer för 'Stadsfällor'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness hälsar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood sångaren Teddy Swims välkommen för att kolla in folk som ser ut att 'Förlora kontrollen', får faderliga råd i 'Pappavisdomar' och sparkar i väg problemen i 'Visa vägen ut'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness Rob har Steelo och Lolo Wood svårt att sätta sig på grund av 'Stolstölder', stöter på oväntade djur i 'Djurchock' och tar sig tid att ramla i 'Tröga trillare'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness Rob trycker Steelo och gästen Lolo Wood läpparna mot 'Bilpussare', får ett slag under bältet i 'Skrevslagna damer' och tappar aptiten fullständigt när de hänger med 'Aptitgrusare'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness upptäcker Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood att telefoner kan vara distraherande i 'Telefonblind', träffar barn som behöver välja en ny sport i 'Minigolfare' och besöker platser där det är 'Kalaskallt'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness dyker Rob, Steelo och gästvärden Lolo Wood huvudstupa in i 'Dyk var som helst', hämtar cyklarna för att 'Trampa i pölen' och bevittnar löshårskatastrofer i 'Tupén är på vift'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt ser Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood vad som händer när man inte sätter landningen i 'Missade landningar', kollar in lojala pojkvänner i 'Jag är tingad' och avslutar med olyckliga campare i "Glamorlös camping'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness kraschar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood med stil i 'Åker över styre', går på mjuk mark i 'Fallgolv' och beger sig till affären alldeles för sent i 'Farolivs'.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Åklagaren i Phoenix ringer till Allison för att be om hennes hjälp med att välja ut en jury. Han behöver en jury som med säkerhet kommer att ge ett skyldigt utslag och utdöma dödsstraff.

programme.title: Medium

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison fortsätter att drömma om en flicka som kastar sig från en klippa ner i en ravin. Till slut ger sig Allison ut för att hitta denna flicka, som visar sig vara någon som dejtade en försvarsadvokats son.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons bror är värvad i USA:s armé och Allison blir skakad till grunden och känslomässigt dränerad när hon drömmer om hans död.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Ariel har drömmar om en ung flicka som försvunnit. I hennes drömmar är flickan tillsammans med ett "träsktroll" som håller henne mot hennes vilja.

programme.title: Medium

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Medan Allison är sjuk och vilar, tar hennes sjukdom överhanden och hon slumrar in. Medan hon drömmer tas hon med in i världen bakom kulisserna till det tv-program hon tittade på.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En knarkkung avrättas för sina brott och Allison är på plats för att bevittna avrättningen. Efter avrättningen kallas Allison till platsen för ett mord där vittnena svär på att det är knarkkungens spöke som är mördaren.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E20 - We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends the peace talks between the Scarrans and the Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E20 - We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E21 - We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. Their plan failed, the crew has little choice but to help Scorpius's true agenda.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E21 - We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E22 - Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole as those flowers grow there.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E1 - Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton attempts to propel his module at high speeds but is hit by a radiation wave and is sucked through a wormhole.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E2 - Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon, automatically broadcasting its exact location to any Peacekeeper forces in the area.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E2 - Exodus From Genesis

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E3 - Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E3 - Back And Back And Back To The Future

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E4 - Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured and held for ransom by some bounty hunters.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E4 - Throne For A Loss

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E5 - PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: After finding the legendary Peacekeeper battleship, Zelbinion, dead in space Crichton, Aeryn, and D'Argo find a Peacekeeper tech under Crais's command.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E5 - PK Tech Girl

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E6 - Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet full of happy workers. Soon D'Argo and Zhaan start working and refuse to return to the ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E6 - Thank God It's Friday, Again

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E7 - I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E8 - That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton's spirit is captured by Maldis. The sorcerer thrives on vengeance and hate, he brings Crais's spirit down. And the two spirits battle.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E8 - That Old Black Magic

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E9 - DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew, promising them that he would be able to use it to find the location of their home planets.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E9 - DNA Mad Scientist

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E10 - They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute, destroys a Peacekeeper shield and gets ejected into open space.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E10 - They've Got A Secret

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E11 - 'Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: While flying Crichton's ship near a sun with high flare activity, John and Aeryn narrowly avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E11 - 'Til The Blood Runs Clear

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E12 - The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but unfortunately they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E13 - Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: The crew finds a colony of Delvians. Z'han goes down to be with her own people for a while, but one of them wants something from Z'han.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E13 - Rhapsody In Blue

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E14 - Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlar gör sitt bästa för att fånga parens uppmärksamhet. Vid den första Lägerelden är paren på helspänn. Ett par lär sig hur svårt det är att motstå frestelse.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En överraskande eliminering skakar om husen. Paren dyker djupare in i experimentet. Vissa partners inser att de kommer allt längre från varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny överraskning skakar om båda villorna. Great och Nafeesah fördjupar sin relation, medan Hall drar en slutsats som förändrar allt. Marisela hittar tillbaka till sig själv när skulden börjar hinna ikapp Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Temptation Light är en ständig påminnelse att det inte finns några hemligheter på ön och att alla aktioner har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det är dags för videomeddelanden, och Mark avslöjar ännu en twist. Även singlarna får nu skicka videomeddelanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren hanterar efterspelet efter videomeddelandena. Nya relationer växer sig starkare och blir intimare. Andra deltagare kämpar med skuldkänslor och osäkerheten på hur allt ska sluta.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren beger sig på övernattningsdejter med deras favoritsinglar. Nya romanser blossar upp, kärleksförklaringar och framtidsplaner görs upp. En till person ger efter för frestelsen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren Marisela & Christopher och Vanessa & Robert återförenas för deras sista Lägereld. Var deras relationer tillräckligt starka för att överleva Temptation Island?

programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands ven Brad, der ved et uheld for flere år siden blev usynlig, kommer på besøg. Der går ikke længe før alle er blevet trætte af ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Afsløreren
programme.desc: Henry og Ray forsøger at stoppe en yderst irriterende forbryder, der kalder sig for Afsløreren. Piper når grænsen, i forsøget på at komme med i en utroligt populær Kaptajn Mand fanklub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand får Henry med i hans yndlings gameshow, Spin og Vind, i forsøget på at nå til bunds i en række forbrydelser. Men Henry ender med selv at blive offer for den samme slags forbrydelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Supervulkanen
programme.desc: Da en supervulkan under Swellview ser ud til at kunne gå i udbrud, bliver Henry og Ray overbeviste om, at Verden snart går under. Piper er overbevist om at hun har glutenallergi.

programme.desc: Catfish, det populære MTV-show, der samler par, der kun har interageret via skærme. I løbet af måneder blev de angiveligt forelskede, men hvad vil der ske, når de mødes i virkeligheden for første gang?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scratching The Surface
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 14
programme.desc: This episode includes: Anastasia Pts 1 & 2, J.D. Method, Interstate Disappearance and Glendeen's Goal.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 15
programme.desc: This episode includes: Two for the Road, Boston Healer, Niqui Bride, Bad Dad, Update: Baby Broker and Amazon Women.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 16

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Fyrene viser deres bløde siger, når deres mødre afslører pinlige detaljer. Stephen bliver ekstremt paranoid på grund af Gios intresse for Julia. Francesca bliver fanget i Gios klør.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Pulling Punches
programme.desc: En fest med Adam og Eva-tema fører til jalousi, når parrene blandes. En kærlighedstrekant tager form, og der bliver ballade, når John, Tyler, Stephen og Gio prøver at forstå deres forvirrede hjerter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations
programme.desc: En pinlig udfordring får ekserne til at begynde at sprede rygter. Gio og Stephen får endelig sandheden at vide om Julia.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Third Eye Blind
programme.desc: Gamle konflikter kommer op til overfladen og et stort skænderi fører til chok og tårer. Med kun to parceremonier tilbage prøver deltagerne desperat at lave en strategi for at vinde.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet, da den tiende og sidste parceremoni nærmer sig. Strategien fører gruppen til at tro på visse par, men Asaf er splittet mellem at følge sit hjerte eller sit team.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love
programme.desc: 22 singler flytter ind i et hus i New Orleans og prøver at sætte 11 perfekte par sammen for at vinde en million dollar. Par falder pladask for hinanden og kærlighedstrekanter dannes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: Malcoms opfører sig som en rigtig player og kommer i klemme mellem Diandra og Nurys. Keith og Alexis prøver at knuse hinandens hjerter ved at date andre.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love in Limbo
programme.desc: De stærkeste par i huset bliver angrebet, da folk begynder at stille spørgsmålstegn ved deres stærke bånd. Michael ryster huset, da han prøver at ødelægge flere forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl
programme.desc: En harmløs leg bliver enden på et par. Frustrationerne vokser mellem par, der knytter sig for meget til hinanden og singler, der har svært ved at skabe kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Der bliver kaos i huset, da Kareems tiltrækning af Zoe får Alivia til at bryde ud i gråd. Alles nerver er på højkant, da pigerne vælger at følge en strategi til parceremonien.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada bliver rasende, da Uche angriber hende for at lægge an på Clinton. To 'on-off'-par finder sammen igen. Pigernes familier afslører pinlige oplysninger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan ikke klare, at Malcolm og Diandra finder sammen. Huset er splittet mellem par, der nægter at splitte op, og singler, der har svært ved at knytte bånd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 singler tager springet og flytter ind i et hus på Hawaii for at prøve at finde 11 perfekte par og vinde en million dollar. Jalousi spreder sig, når par dannes hurtigt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak provokerer Bria, når han flirter med andre kvinder, og hele huset bliver inddraget i dramaet. Tevin og Kenyas letsindige opførsel truer deres spirande forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: En mand forsøger at transportere en gammel pistol ved navn The Mexican, der menes at være forbandet, tilbage over grænsen, mens hans kæreste presser ham til at opgive sit kriminelle liv.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: For three showgirls it was the dream of a lifetime, a four week cabaret engagement in Alice Springs. The problem is simply getting there intact, along with their bus Priscilla. It's not easy being a drag queen in the outback!

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fået sit diplom og et job hos Callahan Auto Parts. Men familieforetagendet begynder at gå nedad bakke, og Tommy kører af sted med sin fars højre hånd, en dumsmart talknuser.

programme.title: Boys And Girls
programme.desc: Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) og Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunne ikke være mere forskellige. Som børn hadede de hinanden. Som voksne binder deres forskelle dem sammen i denne sjove RomCom fra instruktøren bag SHE'S ALL THAT.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: New York, 1921. Den polske kvinde Ewa sejler til Amerika i jagten på et nyt liv. Her møder hun den charmerende, men ondskabsfulde mand Bruno, der presser hende ud i prostitution. Men tryllekunstneren Orlando kan blive hendes håb og redning fra Bruno.

programme.title: Kolbøttefabrikken
programme.desc: Den alternative behandler Acacia kommer galt afsted med en klient og ender med at blive dømt til en psykiatrisk udredning.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby: Part 1
programme.desc: Rosemary (Zoe Saldana) og Guy (Patrick J. Adams) starter et nyt liv i Paris, hvor en god gerning fører til venskab med et rigt og magtfuldt par, der måske skjuler en mørk hemmelighed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When law enforcement officers become targets, no one is safe. So when a crystal meth dealer on the run from the law began shooting cops, it took more than police to stop him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a paramilitary faction used bombs and robbery to further their cause, they crossed the line. The well-organized terror cell was difficult to define, and even harder to stop.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a woman disappeared from her Memphis home. When the ransom went uncollected, the FBI suspected a desperate amateur and feared the worst.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Caught in the act, a disguised bank robber hurled explosives at police and disappeared in a hail of bullets. When police identified the suspect, they connected him to an armed kidnapping, but they couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

programme.title: Sidste Chance
programme.desc: En falsk anklaget mand må forsøge at overleve en offentlig henrettelse iscenesat som et gameshow på TV.

programme.title: Santastein
programme.desc: Da Max Causey var seks år, kom han ved et uheld til at dræbe julemanden. 12 år senere retter Max sin fejl ved at genoplive ham, men indser hurtigt, at den skabning, han har skabt, er en blodtørstig dræber – og den er på vej til hans vens julefest.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Defiance er den utrolige men sande historie om tre brødre, som under 2. Verdenskrig sætter sig op mod den massive tyske besættelsesmagt.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Tre mænd genoplever deres sorgløse collegetid ved at dræbe så mange hjerneceller, de kan, i denne forskruede komedie. Mitch kommer hjem fra en mindre behagelig forretningsrejse og afslører sin kone Heidi midt i en trekant.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris og Justin Long serverer grinene som unge tjenere og servitricer, der søger en mening med livet, kærligheden og venskabet i denne forrygende komedie.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er tryllekunstner, men skeptisk overfor det overnaturlige. Han møder den clairvoyante Sophie Baker (Emma Stone) og skal afsløre hendes tricks, men kan ikke finde nogen. Er der mon mere mellem himmel og jord?

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fået sit diplom og et job hos Callahan Auto Parts. Men familieforetagendet begynder at gå nedad bakke, og Tommy kører af sted med sin fars højre hånd, en dumsmart talknuser.

programme.title: Præsidentkandidaten
programme.desc: En mand slutter sig til den politiske kampagne for en snu kandidat til præsident i USA.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman pleads self-defense in the stabbing death of her allegedly abusive husband.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A financier lives after his socialite wife shoots him six times in their Calgary condo.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman shoots her allegedly abusive husband in his sleep.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman shoots her abusive common-law husband after he leaves her and their two children for another woman.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Shipman
programme.desc: Doctor Harold Shipman was convicted of killing 15 patients in 2000, but he is thought to have killed up to 215. Discover how he was eventually caught by detectives.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stephanie Slater
programme.desc: Estate agent Stephanie Slater reveals the story of her abduction, rape and incarceration, which occurred in 1992 whilst showing a man around a house.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Russell Murders
programme.desc: Bludgeoned to death whilst walking down a country lane, the horrific murders of Lin and Megan Russell made worldwide news. Discover the events of that shocking day.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Beverly Allitt
programme.desc: Beverley Allitt was thought to be a 'model' nurse. Very astute, caring and always willing to help, why did she murder four children and attempt to kill 11 others?

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E01.The 419 Scam & Moving Fraud
programme.desc: No one is immune to this popular form of the age-old advance loan fraud known as the 419 scam.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E02.Counterfeit Money & Mortgage Fraud
programme.desc: Are you sure the money in your pocket is real and would you be able to tell the difference and if you did find a fake bill, what should you do with it - we’re about to show you.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E03.Charity Fraud & Investment Fraud
programme.desc: This story will show how scam artists take advantage of people's generosity to charities.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E04.Mortgage Fraud & Charity Fraud
programme.desc: A travel agent is sentenced to four years for defrauding over 30 customers out of more than $278,000 in bogus vacation packages.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E05.Home Renovation Fraud & Debit Skimming
programme.desc: There are many ways, simple and sophisticated, of grabbing your debit card information including you PIN number. This story features rare police surveillance footage of criminal technology used to gather this information and take your money.
programme.sub-title: Fraud Squad.S01E05.Home Renovation Fraud & Debit Skimming

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E06.Identity Fraud & Lottery-Prize Fraud
programme.desc: One of the most tragic victims in the world of fraud are the elderly. In this story an 83-year-old woman loses most of her belongings by financing promises of lottery winnings.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E07.Employment Scam & Adoption Fraud
programme.desc: A college student trying to earn some extra cash and finds himself involved in a job where instead of making money, he loses it due to a fraudulent cheque

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E08.Pump and Dump & Used Car Fraud
programme.desc: Repeat Fraudster Harris Dempsey ''Butch'' Ballow wasted no time when he was released on bail after being convicted of a stock fraud. He set up another stock scam taking more than $3 million.
programme.sub-title: Fraud Squad.S01E08.Pump and Dump & Used Car Fraud

programme.title: Partners In Crime: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: The details of Myra Hindley’s childhood and upbringing, leading up to her meeting Ian Brady.

programme.title: Partners In Crime: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: The stories of the murders told through the prism of the ones that got away.

programme.title: Partners In Crime: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: Once jailed Myra Hindley focused all her energies into trying to get released.

programme.title: Under Arrest: My Name Is Mr. Duck
programme.desc: A suspected sex trade worker is assaulted, a drunk suspect attacks police after crashing into their vehicle and a man under arrest becomes violent inside a police car.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Put Some Clothes On
programme.desc: Police confront a man with a gun on a busy road, a stark naked suspect high on drugs roams the streets and police attend a call of shots fired.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Wrong Side of the Road
programme.desc: Police pursuit ends when a stolen vehicle crashes into a house, a violent suspect bites police and police investigate suspicious activity in a van.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Driving on Three Wheels
programme.desc: A high-speed chase of a stolen sports car takes place, police attend a violent domestic dispute and a suspect arrested with a sex trade worker accuses police of racism.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Mud Wrestlers
programme.desc: Suspect with an assault weapon terrorizes neighbors, a son with a knife threatens his father, police dog tracks a gang of vehicle thieves.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Bullets Through Glass
programme.desc: Police investigate a bloody machete attack, stolen vehicle leads police on a high-speed chase and thugs assault the wrong man and pay the price.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Who Needs a Uniform?
programme.desc: Police investigate a violent lovers quarrel, a thief tries to rob a policeman's house and a police dog apprehends escaping car thieves.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Hogtied Husband
programme.desc: Police overpower a man with a knife, a naked suspect high on drugs threatens his family and a domestic dispute continues in jail.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Wash Your Hands
programme.desc: Police arrest an abusive boyfriend, divers search for a drowning victim at a public beach and a trio of suspects are caught after a robbery.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: Helen was convicted in the 1986 murder of her son-in-law, who was shot execution-style in the back of the head. In 2008, Jennifer walked into the maternity ward of a Florida hospital and smuggled a 1-day-old baby out of the facility in a duffle bag.

programme.title: South Park: Stanleys Cup

programme.title: South Park: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Drengene bruger spillet Minecraft til at forhindre sine forældre I at skade hinanden.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1

programme.sub-title: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer kvarteret

programme.title: South Park: Rødtotter
programme.desc: Cartman lider af et tilfælde af 'Gingervitus' og tager kampen op mod forfølgelsen af hans rødhårede fæller.

programme.title: South Park: Goth Kids 3: Posørernes dag
programme.desc: Goth-ungerne sendes på en lejr for problembørn.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 3
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er strandet i Imaginationland og må kæmpe for livet mod en hær af onde kræfter. Kyle og Cartman er stadig i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: En million små fibre
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bog, og den bliver udvalgt til Oprahs bogklub. Den bliver en bestseller for folk, som prøver at bekæmpe deres afhængighed.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kendisser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøgelse nægter at acceptere sin hedengang og efterlader resten af de nylig afdøde berømtheder frustrerede i Skærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Krøblingekamp!
programme.desc: Big Gay Al vender tilbage til South Park men bliver kasseret som spejderfører, fordi han er bøsse.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantændelse
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park eksploderer tilfældigt. Stans far er et af tilfældene.

programme.title: South Park: Chef vender tilbage
programme.desc: Byen er begejstret, da Chef vender hjem efter at have rejst rundt i verden med 'The Super Adventure Club.'

programme.title: South Park: Faith Hilling
programme.desc: Den seneste meme-mode i byen er 'Faith Hilling', men trenden går af mode da Faith Hilling afbryder republikanernes præsidentdebat.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomer (underbukse-gnomer)
programme.desc: Drengene skal skrive en opgave til skolen. Tweek foreslår, at de skriver om gnomer, der besøger ham hver nat og stjæler hans underbukser.

programme.title: South Park: Den ustuearrest-bare
programme.desc: Led og ked af hvordan han bliver behandlet af sine forældre, tager den altid uskyldige Butters den nye vampyr-galskab til sig, lidt for entusiastisk.

programme.title: South Park: Den sidste meehicaner
programme.desc: Da et spil 'grænsekontrol' går galt antænder Butters mexicansk stolthed, men Cartman er ikke villig til at holde op, mens legen stadig er god.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle inviterer Butters i stedet for Cartman til sin fødselsdagsfest, så Cartman bilder Butters ind, at en meteor vil ramme jorden og lukker ham inde i et beskyttelsesrum, så han selv kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye dreng i klassen overtaler Jesus til at slås med hans far, Satan, i det endelige slag mellem det gode og det onde. Cartman bliver rasende over at høre, at sammenstødet falder sammen med hans fødselsdagsfest.

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee hårtamponer
programme.desc: Kyle har brug for en nyretransplantation, og Cartman er den perfekte donor. Men Cartman sætter en høj pris på sin nyre: 10 millioner dollars.

programme.title: South Park: Det bryder løs
programme.desc: 'Du ved hvad' bryder løs, da indbyggerne i South Park hører ordet '****' i det populære show 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: South Park: Seerkrigen
programme.desc: Drengene bliver inddraget i en seerkrig, da deres 'Super School News' er i fare for at blive nedlagt, og de vil bruge alle midler for at tiltrække seere.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans utrolige gave
programme.desc: Et uheldigt forsøg på at flyve bringer Cartman på hospitalet. Da politiet tror, at han har særlige overnaturlige evner for opklarelse af forbrydelser, ansætter de ham til hjælpe med at fange en seriemorder.

programme.title: South Park: Er du der, Gud, det er mig, Jesus
programme.desc: Cartman hævder, at han er kommet i puberteten til de andre drenges store misundelse, og Jesus lover at give folkene i South Park en nytårsforestilling.
programme.sub-title: Er du der, Gud, det er mig, Jesus

programme.title: South Park: Bvadr, en penis!
programme.desc: Ms. Garrison vil gerne være mand igen, så mens han er væk fra skolen, bliver Cartmann vikar.

programme.title: South Park: Højere standard
programme.desc: Cartman indrømmer endelig, at han er fed, og anskaffer sig en el-scooter.

programme.title: South Park: Rektor PC's endelige retfærdighed
programme.desc: Kyle prioriterer en farlig alliance højere end sit venskab med Stan.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at pigerne har et apparat, som kan se ind i fremtiden, så Butters klæder sig ud som pige for at infiltrere dem.

programme.title: South Park: Røde slæde styrtet
programme.desc: Med julemandens, Mr. Hankey og Jesus' hjælp, forsøger Cartman at bringe julen til Iraks underkuede befolkning.

programme.title: South Park: En helt elendig jul
programme.desc: Kyle og Ike venter spændt på Mr. Hankey. Da han ikke dukker op, ringer Kyle til de andre og indkalder til et sent krisemøde.

programme.title: South Park: Eric Cartman er død
programme.desc: Da alle beslutter sig for at ignorere Cartman, er han overbevist om, at han er død og må finde fred ved at undskylde for sine tidligere misgerninger.

programme.title: South Park: Wall-Mart er på vej
programme.desc: Da Wall-Mart forvandler South Park til en spøgelsesby, prøver Stan og Kyle at ødelægge forretningen, men en besat Cartman står dem i vejen.
